organizations_name_check.name: organizations_name_check
organizations_name_check.value: char_length("organizations"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "organizations"."name" = btrim("organizations"."name") AND "organizations"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

memberships_insert_admin.name: memberships_insert_admin
memberships_insert_admin.withCheck: "memberships"."organization_id" IN (SELECT private.user_admin_org_ids()) AND "memberships"."active" AND "memberships"."created_at" = now() AND "memberships"."updated_at" = now()

contacts_phone_normalized_check.name: contacts_phone_normalized_check
contacts_phone_normalized_check.value: "contacts"."phone_normalized" IS NULL OR ("contacts"."phone" IS NOT NULL AND "contacts"."phone_normalized" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{1,14}$')

opportunities_loss_reason_stage_check.name: opportunities_loss_reason_stage_check
opportunities_loss_reason_stage_check.value: ("opportunities"."stage" = 'lost' AND "opportunities"."loss_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("opportunities"."stage" <> 'lost' AND "opportunities"."loss_reason" IS NULL)

opportunities_loss_notes_check.name: opportunities_loss_notes_check
opportunities_loss_notes_check.value: char_length("opportunities"."loss_notes") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "opportunities"."loss_notes" = btrim("opportunities"."loss_notes", ' ' || chr(10)) AND translate("opportunities"."loss_notes", chr(10), '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

opportunities_sale_price_check.name: opportunities_sale_price_check
opportunities_sale_price_check.value: ("opportunities"."sale_price" IS NULL) = ("opportunities"."sale_currency" IS NULL) AND ("opportunities"."sale_price" IS NULL OR ("opportunities"."sale_price" > 0 AND ("opportunities"."sale_currency" <> 'PYG' OR "opportunities"."sale_price" = trunc("opportunities"."sale_price"))))

opportunities_won_closure_check.name: opportunities_won_closure_check
opportunities_won_closure_check.value: ("opportunities"."stage" = 'won' AND "opportunities"."vehicle_id" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."sale_price" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."sale_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."payment_method" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."delivery_status" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."delivery_date" IS NOT NULL) OR ("opportunities"."stage" <> 'won' AND "opportunities"."sale_price" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."sale_currency" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."payment_method" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."delivery_status" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."delivery_date" IS NULL)

vehicles_price_check.name: vehicles_price_check
vehicles_price_check.value: ("vehicles"."price" IS NULL) = ("vehicles"."currency" IS NULL) AND ("vehicles"."price" IS NULL OR ("vehicles"."price" > 0 AND ("vehicles"."currency" <> 'PYG' OR "vehicles"."price" = trunc("vehicles"."price"))))

opportunity_demand_facts_insert_member.name: opportunity_demand_facts_insert_member
opportunity_demand_facts_insert_member.withCheck: "opportunity_demand_facts"."organization_id" IN (SELECT private.user_org_ids()) AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."source_kind" = 'member' AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."status" IN ('confirmed', 'corrected', 'rejected') AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."recorded_by" = (select auth.uid()) AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."recorded_at" = now()

opportunity_demand_facts_value_check.name: opportunity_demand_facts_value_check
opportunity_demand_facts_value_check.value:
CASE
        WHEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."status" = 'rejected' THEN num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand", "opportunity_demand_facts"."model", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max", "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount", "opportunity_demand_facts"."currency", "opportunity_demand_facts"."purchase_type", "opportunity_demand_facts"."trade_in") = 0
        WHEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."fact" = 'desired_vehicle' THEN num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand", "opportunity_demand_facts"."model") >= 1 AND num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max", "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount", "opportunity_demand_facts"."currency", "opportunity_demand_facts"."purchase_type", "opportunity_demand_facts"."trade_in") = 0
        WHEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."fact" = 'year_range' THEN num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max") >= 1 AND coalesce("opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100, true) AND coalesce("opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100, true) AND coalesce("opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min" <= "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max", true) AND num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand", "opportunity_demand_facts"."model", "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount", "opportunity_demand_facts"."currency", "opportunity_demand_facts"."purchase_type", "opportunity_demand_facts"."trade_in") = 0
        WHEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."fact" = 'budget_max' THEN num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."amount", "opportunity_demand_facts"."currency") = 2 AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount" > 0 AND ("opportunity_demand_facts"."currency" <> 'PYG' OR "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount" = trunc("opportunity_demand_facts"."amount")) AND num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand", "opportunity_demand_facts"."model", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max", "opportunity_demand_facts"."purchase_type", "opportunity_demand_facts"."trade_in") = 0
        WHEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."fact" = 'down_payment' THEN num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."amount", "opportunity_demand_facts"."currency") = 2 AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount" >= 0 AND ("opportunity_demand_facts"."currency" <> 'PYG' OR "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount" = trunc("opportunity_demand_facts"."amount")) AND num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand", "opportunity_demand_facts"."model", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max", "opportunity_demand_facts"."purchase_type", "opportunity_demand_facts"."trade_in") = 0
        WHEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."fact" = 'purchase_type' THEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."purchase_type" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand", "opportunity_demand_facts"."model", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max", "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount", "opportunity_demand_facts"."currency", "opportunity_demand_facts"."trade_in") = 0
        WHEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."fact" = 'trade_in_intent' THEN "opportunity_demand_facts"."trade_in" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand", "opportunity_demand_facts"."model", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_min", "opportunity_demand_facts"."year_max", "opportunity_demand_facts"."amount", "opportunity_demand_facts"."currency", "opportunity_demand_facts"."purchase_type") = 0
        ELSE false
      END

opportunity_demand_facts_status_target_c.name: opportunity_demand_facts_status_target_check
opportunity_demand_facts_status_target_c.value: ("opportunity_demand_facts"."status" NOT IN ('rejected', 'corrected') OR "opportunity_demand_facts"."target_fact_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("opportunity_demand_facts"."status" <> 'detected' OR ("opportunity_demand_facts"."target_fact_id" IS NULL AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."previous_member_fact_id" IS NULL))

opportunity_demand_facts_self_reference_.name: opportunity_demand_facts_self_reference_check
opportunity_demand_facts_self_reference_.value: ("opportunity_demand_facts"."target_fact_id" IS NULL OR "opportunity_demand_facts"."target_fact_id" <> "opportunity_demand_facts"."id") AND ("opportunity_demand_facts"."previous_member_fact_id" IS NULL OR "opportunity_demand_facts"."previous_member_fact_id" <> "opportunity_demand_facts"."id")

opportunity_demand_facts_text_check.name: opportunity_demand_facts_text_check
opportunity_demand_facts_text_check.value: ("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand" IS NULL OR (char_length("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand") BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."brand" = btrim("opportunity_demand_facts"."brand") AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."brand" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')) AND ("opportunity_demand_facts"."model" IS NULL OR (char_length("opportunity_demand_facts"."model") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."model" = btrim("opportunity_demand_facts"."model") AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."model" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')) AND ("opportunity_demand_facts"."evidence_text" IS NULL OR (char_length("opportunity_demand_facts"."evidence_text") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."evidence_text" = btrim("opportunity_demand_facts"."evidence_text") AND "opportunity_demand_facts"."evidence_text" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'))

opportunity_notes_insert_member.name: opportunity_notes_insert_member
opportunity_notes_insert_member.withCheck: "opportunity_notes"."organization_id" IN (SELECT private.user_org_ids()) AND "opportunity_notes"."recorded_by" = (select auth.uid()) AND "opportunity_notes"."recorded_at" = now()

opportunity_notes_body_check.name: opportunity_notes_body_check
opportunity_notes_body_check.value: char_length("opportunity_notes"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND "opportunity_notes"."body" = btrim("opportunity_notes"."body", ' ' || chr(10)) AND translate("opportunity_notes"."body", chr(10), '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

messages_insert_member.name: messages_insert_member
messages_insert_member.withCheck: "messages"."organization_id" IN (SELECT private.user_org_ids()) AND "messages"."recorded_by" = (select auth.uid()) AND "messages"."created_at" = now() AND "messages"."conversation_id" IS NULL

messages_content_check.name: messages_content_check
messages_content_check.value: char_length("messages"."content") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND "messages"."content" = btrim("messages"."content", ' ' || chr(10)) AND translate("messages"."content", chr(10), '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

messages_source_check.name: messages_source_check
messages_source_check.value: ("messages"."recorded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."conversation_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."external_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."sent_at" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."recorded_by" IS NULL AND "messages"."conversation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."channel" = 'whatsapp' AND "messages"."direction" = 'inbound') OR ("messages"."recorded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."conversation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."channel" = 'whatsapp' AND "messages"."direction" = 'outbound')
